scope: Assertion, scoreboard, directed/random scenario, and coverage planning only; no SVA implementation, RTL, cycle bound, or PPA claim.

records.contract_invariant: All payload, sidecar, and descriptor traffic has the unique R1 path.
records.sva_property: safety: no alternate external-memory request producer
records.directed_test: descriptor maintenance and payload write share R1

records.contract_invariant: metadata_publish_commit is the sole authority/visibility linearization.
records.sva_property: safety: publish implies durable payload, complete P3, staged M2, durable descriptor

records.contract_invariant: ready-low delays only; it changes no cursor, payload, ownership, credit, mask, or admission.
Page reuse follows quiescence and durable descriptor invalidation.
records.sva_property: safety: bitmap free implies invalidation durable and no-live-reference predicate
records.environment_assumption: external completions eventually arrive for progress only

records.contract_invariant: R4 numeric_fault becomes exactly one R6 outward terminal fault after GQA commits.
records.sva_property: safety: numeric_fault cannot terminalize before four commits or twice
records.directed_test: inject numeric fault before/after final commit
records.coverage_bin: each source subset and fault timing

records.contract_invariant: Pre-reset replies and raw HBM bytes cannot become reachable after reset/init.
records.sva_property: safety: old epoch response cannot mutate post-reset identity
records.directed_test: inject matching stale response after reuse
records.random_scenario: reset amid all live request classes
records.environment_assumption: adapter suppresses/drains old replies before mem_init_done

records.contract_invariant: retire_ack waits for R1/R2/R3/R5/S2/direct/merge drain membership.
records.sva_property: safety: ack implies every named drain acknowledgement
records.environment_assumption: each external completion eventually occurs for progress only

records.contract_invariant: Each retained live token has exactly one hot/pending/packed authority.
FIFO ordinal, ownership, and logical credit are preserved under legal stalls.
records.sva_property: safety: grant order and credit conservation
records.coverage_bin: all R2 classes and credit boundaries

records.contract_invariant: S2/direct source release occurs only after all four consumer partial commits.
Delayed old identity cannot alter reused S2/direct READY, ownership, or terminal outcome.
records.sva_property: safety: mismatched identity/generation has no state transition

records.contract_invariant: Every accepted request has at most one terminal outcome and no Full-KV fallback.
records.sva_property: safety: terminal is onehot; no fallback dispatch bit

records.contract_invariant: Accepted request eventually reaches one terminal outcome.
records.random_scenario: fixed-seed legal stalls with fairness release
records.environment_assumption: accepted external requests eventually complete and consumers eventually accept

records.contract_invariant: Retire request eventually receives matching acknowledgement.
records.directed_test: retire after injected live work drains
records.environment_assumption: external completions and all named drain members eventually acknowledge

records.contract_invariant: Reserved credit returns on its terminal path.
records.directed_test: reserve then success and fault terminals
records.environment_assumption: bound request reaches a terminal completion
